notes.title: Minor Update: Multi-Language Voice-Overs + Bugfixes for Local Songs & Playlists
notes.notes:
Dear community,

This is just a minor update before the next big thing is coming 😉 to fix recently reported bugs and also add some voice-overs to our tutorial and the feature tour. 

Here are the changes in detail:
[list]
[*] The in-game tutorial and feature tour do now have voice-overs in multiple languages.
[*] Changing the BPM while playing a local song no longer causes weird effects.
[*] The buttons on the song endscreen are now more visually distinct to prevent users from accidentally pressing the main menu button during playlists.
[*] Playlists with more than 2 pages no longer show odd scrolling behavior in the main menu.
[/list] 

As always, thanks for all your valuable feedback and reporting those nasty bugs!

Feel free to share more feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord channel[/url], vote on user requests on our [url=https://feedback.powerbeatsvr.com]feedback board[/url], or add your own ideas there.

Thank you all,
Team PowerBeatsVR

notes.title: New Update: Engine Upgrade, Generator Improvements, and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Dear community,

we’ve just laid the technical groundwork for upcoming new features with this update, so you can enjoy more cool new stuff in the future and an even better performance right now. Stay tuned for more info!

We’ve also addressed some of the most pressing requests regarding the recent switch from generator version 1.0 to 2.0. Here are the changes regarding the generator:
[list]
[*] Optimized the gaps between different patterns to create a more consistent workout flow
[*] Fixed the generation of expert mode workouts for low bpm songs
[/list]

The update also includes several bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the endless loading screen that occurred on certain hardware combinations
[*] Fixed an editor bug where objects could be placed beyond the end of a song
[*] Fixed some translation issues in the main menu
[/list]

As always, thanks for all your valuable feedback! It helps us to make PowerBeatsVR even better 😊

Feel free to share further feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord channel[/url], vote on user requests on our [url=https://feedback.powerbeatsvr.com]feedback board[/url], or add your own ideas there.

Thank you all,
the devs

notes.title: New Update: Usability, On-Boarding & Generator Improvements + New Languages
notes.notes:
Dear community!

We have some exciting news: PowerBeatsVR has been released [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4336749139724039/]on the official Meta Quest store[/url] a few days ago. Along with that release came [b]a new update, which we've now also released on PCVR! :)[/b]

The new update features a heavily polished version with better onboarding, tutorials, improved usability, new languages, and an enhanced generator for your own music. With more to come in the next few months …

Here is the full list of changes and improvements:

[h3]Improved On-Boarding:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Tutorial Demo Stage to introduce the game mechanics to new users
[*] Added Feature Tour to introduce the main features to new users
[/list]
[h3]New Features:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new Generator Input UI – With the first of our “Generator 2.0” updates we provide a new user interface that gives users even more freedom to choose their specific playstyle with a very clear and precise input structure
[*] Added additional languages: Chinese (Traditional), Thai, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish
[/list]
[h3]Changes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Mute” button has been switched
[*] Text on start screen has been reduced
[/list]
[h3]Other Improvements:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added additional scroll option by joystick
[*] Added highlighting to main features (Playlists / Modifiers / …)
[*] Added “Reset” button for Option Panel
[*] Added help screen for Local File Browser
[*] Improved Usability & Visuals of main menu and song editor
[/list]

Enjoy the update, and thanks for your awesome support and helping us in making PowerBeatsVR even better :)

Cheers,
the devs

P.S. As always, feel free to ask questions, discuss, or share your feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord channel[/url]. We highly appreciate your ideas and thoughts! We also have a [url=http://feedback.powerbeatsvr.com/]feedback board[/url] where you can submit ideas and wishes, vote on specific requests, and see what’s already in development. So, feel free, to contribute there as well.

notes.title: New Update: Live Workout Creator & Custom Environments
notes.notes:
Dear community!

[b]We have exciting news: PowerBeatsVR just got another major update that features 
[list]
[*] a new live workout creator that makes building your own workouts a breeze
[*] and custom environments (as our first DLC) for countless training surroundings.
[/list][/b]

Besides that, we’ve implemented a live squat counter, optimized the performance and some existing workouts, and improved the built-in screenshot feature, so you can share your awesome stats even better.

[previewyoutube=WMGMOvUpLJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Now back to the [url=https://www.powerbeatsvr.com/vr-fitness-game/new-level-editor/]live workout creator[/url], which is another new feature of the improved in-game editor: [b]You basically move and box to your music and the editor builds the according layout automatically.[/b] Using that feature, workout creation has never been easier in any VR fitness app!

As you all know, we are ambitious about giving you the power to customize your workouts exactly to your needs. The [url=https://www.powerbeatsvr.com/custom-environments/]Custom Environments DLC[/url] takes this customizability to the next level: [b]Once you have it, you have access to 8 beautiful built-in skybox environments and the option to use your own skybox/360° panorama/photosphere files as additional workout environments.[/b] 

You can find a myriad of suitable panorama files online, and also create your own images with Google Street View or a 360° camera. There are now virtually no limits on where you are going to work out in VR!

Enjoy the update, and thanks for all your valuable feedback, incredible support, and enthusiasm! Speaking of feedback, feel free to share further feedback in our [url=https://discord.powerbeatsvr.com/]Discord channel[/url], vote on user requests on our [url=https://feedback.powerbeatsvr.com/]feedback board[/url], or add your own ideas there. 

[b]And as always, reviews are much appreciated, and would make our day as they help us a lot <3[/b]

Thank you all,
the devs

notes.title: v3.3.1: Modifier & Editor Update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

Another new update from us here at PowerBeatsVR central, addressing two of the most important feature requests you made on our feedback websites: No double balls, and no streams modifiers. And some other improvements as well:

[h3]Modifiers:[/h3]
- Added "No Double Ball" modifier: Converts double hits into single, boxing-style hits
- Added "No Streams" modifier: Converts streams into balls
- Rearranged the modifiers and placed them in the GAMEPLAY panel next to environments and weapons

[h3]Performance Improvements:[/h3]
- Significantly sped up the leaderboard loading 

[h3]Editor Improvements:[/h3]
- Added visualization to pattern selection
- Added handle for free menu placement
- Added highlighting to selected range
- Added waveform to vertical slider
- Added "Clear All", "Clear Range", "Clear Stream" buttons
- Removed some dialogs after copying or pasting patterns
- Fixed non-deletable stream fragments

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
- Fixed incorrect combo breaks on incoming streams
- Fixed delayed streams

Enjoy!

The devs[img]

notes.title: New Update: Added All Improvements and Features From the Oculus Quest Release
notes.notes:
Dear players!

It has been a while since our last update on Steam, but now it's finally here: [b]You can now enjoy all improvements that we've made during the [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4336749139724039/]Oculus Quest port[/url] here on Steam as well.[/b] You can see the complete list of changes further below. Sorry for the delay. We are now back on track!

From now on, both platforms share the same codebase and are almost identical - except for slightly better graphics and heart rate monitor support on PCVR. Future updates will be published on all platforms likewise. 

Btw, here is our new trailer showing you some changes already:
[previewyoutube=wTyfUnp4NeU;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your patience! As always, feel free to share your feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord channel[/url] or here in the Steam community, vote on user requests, or add your own ideas on our new [url=https://feedback.powerbeatsvr.com]feedback board[/url]. We highly appreciate all your help in making PowerBeatsVR one of the best VR fitness games!

[b]Btw, comments and reviews on Steam are also much appreciated and would make our day <3[/b]

Enjoy the update, and thanks for being part of this community!

Cheers,
the devs

[h2]All Changes and New Features[/h2]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked re-centering feature
[*] Added warning if playspace is not configured, configured to be larger than the one reported by the platform, or the headset is not reporting its guardian correctly
[*] Added safety margin to keep elements inside the configured playspace at all time
[*] Improved automatic adaptation to playspace size and orientation (Please note: Quest via link is not reporting correct boundaries to SteamVR. Thus, there will be a warning.)
[/list] 

[h3]Additional Changes and Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed beat detection by waiting for entire audio file to be loaded successfully
[*] Prevented play area size from changing slightly on every menu call when AUTO is checked
[*] Fixed balls placement in song “Energetic” on Advanced and Expert to prevent collisions with walls
[*] Fixed playlist length longer than one hour not showing hours in the playlist tab
[*] Fixed local file not being shown when file ending is not all lower case
[*] Added tooltips to weapon selection explaining the connection between XP and unlocking status
[*] Fixed haptics to give different feedback for balls and streams
[*] Fixed music starting twice when booting up game (sound hiccup)
[*] Fixed “perfect hits” numerical display on the end screen for large hit values
[*] Added center mark on front border for easier positioning
[*] Muted "Move back" audio warning in main menu
[*] Improved acoustic feedback in all menus
[*] Improved scrolling and slider handling within menu elements
[*] Improved readability of some official songs
[/list] 

[h3]Editor Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistent UI behavior of objects and wording in editor
[*] Improved performance when scrolling through a layout
[/list] 

[h3]Visual Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized, improved, and harmonized environments across all platforms
[*] Optimized and improved menu across all platforms
[*] Changed storm in desert environment to an arch straight out of Arches national park
[*] Improved particle effects and added hit direction to destroy effects
[/list]

notes.title: Oculus Quest Port is Finally Finished - PCVR (Steam) Update is Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Dear players,

This is just a short update about how things are going with the development of PowerBeatsVR: 

We've finally finished the Oculus Quest port and started adapting the PCVR version to the latest changes. You should expect that update in November. Unfortunately, porting took longer and required more resources than planned. That's why there haven't been any updates lately. However, if you are interested in the Quest port, you can find more information here: [url=www.powerbeatsvr.com/oculusquest]www.powerbeatsvr.com/oculusquest[/url]

[b]But now back to PCVR:[/b] After the upcoming update, which is going to align all our platforms, you'll receive the same updates as all other platforms. So, don't worry. We won't abandon our Steam users ;-). This is the platform that started everything!

So, thank you all for your patience!

Cheers,
the devs

notes.title: PowerBeatsVR Full Release is Now Live
notes.notes:
Dear players!

It’s done! We are super excited to announce that PowerBeatsVR has just made its full release with its largest update ever including a [b]second music pack[/b], a [b]new environment[/b], [b]playlist support with shuffle, endurance, and endless mode[/b], [b]and much more[/b]! You can see the complete list of changes and new features further below.

[previewyoutube=JaJeLbBgiEU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]But first, we would like to take the opportunity to thank you all for being part of this community so far![/b] Your enthusiasm since our Early Access launch in April 2019 and all your valuable feedback have shaped PowerBeatsVR and have made it such a great experience as it is today. It really means a lot to us! We hope that we will get that amazing support in the future as well and would love to see you on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord channel[/url] with further great feedback.

the devs

notes.title: Full Release is Coming November 18

We are thrilled to announce that [b]PowerBeatsVR is leaving Early Access on November 18 with a massive set of new features, including a second music pack with 12 songs, a new ‘Sky’ environment, playlist support with shuffle, endurance, and endless mode, and much more[/b]! notes.title: Public BETA Update: New Environment, 2nd Song Pack & More
notes.notes:
Dear players!

The public beta channel just got another exciting update in preparation for the full release. Last time, we added the playlist feature. This time you can have a pre-release look at a new airy environment and a second song pack.

Here is the full list of new features, changes, and bugfixes implemented in the new beta build:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Second song pack (work in progress)
[*] "Sky" environment (work in progress)
[*] "Balls of Steel" modifier
[*] Daily calories goal
[*] Playlist analysis screen
[/list]

[b]Playlist Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the option to change a song's position within a playlist
[*] Improved overall usability and added some instructions
[*] Added a button for jumping to the selected song in the volume or local tabs
[/list]

[b]Other Feature Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Got rid of the leaderboard lag
[*] Increased the size of the shown waveform in the editor
[/list]

[b]Visual Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the scoring screen
[*] Increased the readability of the main menu
[*] Tweaked the visuals of the environments
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed all reported bugs regarding the playlist feature
[*] Fixed the size of the fractures when using the "Smaller Balls" modifier
[*] Fixed a bug where framerates dropped during streams and when using the powerfist
[*] Fixed the laser pointer not being shown on the left powerfist
[/list]

[b]And here is how you can join the beta, if you haven’t already:[/b]
1)	Find PowerBeatsVR in your Steam library and right-click on it.
2)	Click “Properties”.
3)	Open the “Beta” tab.
4)	Under “Select the beta you would like to opt into:” select “publicbeta” from the drop-down.
5)	Close the properties window and the beta will begin installing.

To switch back, just choose “NONE – opt out of all beta programs” in the “Beta” tab instead.[b] When switching back, please make sure to choose another environment than "Sky" before doing that! Otherwise, the default branch won't start properly.[/b]

Feel free to share your feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/6Kqg5Tu]Discord beta channel[/url] or here in the Steam community. We highly appreciate your feedback and your help in making PowerBeatsVR an awesome VR fitness game!

And now have fun and thanks for all your support,
Team PowerBeatsVR

notes.title: New Update: ANT+ Support for HRMs, Automatic Playspace Scaling, ...
notes.notes:
Dear players! 

We’ve just released our "Flatten the Curve" update for PowerBeatsVR, which makes your home workouts even more convenient:

You can now use ANT+ heart rate monitors as well to track your heart rate in-game. We removed the two distinct playspace sizes and player sizes and implemented automatic playspace scaling based on your chaperone/boundary setting and fine-adjustable player height. And we finally added FLAC support besides OGG, WAV, and MP3 to the automatic beatmap generator. 

Here is a full list of changes:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] ANT+ support for heart rate monitors
[*] Automatic playspace scaling based on chaperone/boundary settings
[*] Fine adjustable player height
[*] FLAC music support for the automatic beatmap generator
[*] Manual controller alignment option
[*] Dedicated support for Valve Knuckles & Vive Cosmos controllers
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Knuckle & Index controller orientation and vibration fixed
[*] Limit of custom song directories fixed
[*] Occurring crashes when connecting to Bluetooth HRMs fixed
[/list]

[b]Menu:[/b]
[list]
[*] “Stop Music” button and “Play Music on Return to Menu” toggle added
[/list]

[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[*] New PowerBall visuals
[*] Overall graphics improvements
[/list]

[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Overall performance improvements
[/list]

Now it’s time for the next step: Adding playlists for a stamina mode!

We hope you enjoy the update. As always thank you for all your support! And if you aren’t already in our [url=https://www.discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord community channel[/url] we would love to see you there! Comments and reviews on Steam are also much appreciated <3 Thank you for your support!

Cheers,
Team PowerBeatsVR

notes.title: New Major Update: Auto-Generated Workouts for Your Own Music and Much More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34240477/a2a6e230e0a5c7a9c54d544e35d3e585e2c3d279.jpg[/img]

Dear players!

We’re thrilled to announce another major update for PowerBeatsVR with a special new feature: [b]You can now play with your own music library[/b] and let the game[b] auto-generate suitable workouts[/b] on all three difficulty levels! And if you want to change the workouts to stress specific parts and adapt them to your needs, you have the options for that.

But that’s not all. Based on our players’ feedback, we’ve made the [b]level editor much easier to use[/b] and implemented further features, such as an [b]additional strength and activity bonus[/b], an [b]indicator for the direction to punch multiple targets in a row[/b], the [b]option to choose between curved and straight flight paths for incoming objects[/b], and [b]several game modifiers[/b], amongst them a “Super Speed” modifier.

---
Here are all the changes in detail:

[b]Auto-Generator For Local Music:[/b]
[list]
[*] Automatic beatmap generation for all your local music files 
[*] Beginner, Advanced, and Expert mode
[*] Customization options
[/list]

[b]Improved Level Editor[/b]
[list]
[*] Easy handling: Just choose your local song via the in-game file browser and start editing
[*] Automatic song analysis (including bpm and offset – no manual work necessary)
[*] New feature: Saving and loading of custom patterns
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] New modifiers:
•	„All balls are normal“
•	„No vertical walls“
•	„No horizontal walls“
•	„Super speed“
[*] Additional strength bonus
[*] Additional activity bonus
[*] New indicator for the direction to punch multiple targets in a row
[*] New option for turning in-game voice on/off 
[*] New option for switching between curved and straight flight paths for incoming objects
[*] Visual tweaks and improvements
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]

Special thanks to our beta testers and everyone who gave us feedback! If you also want to help us in making an awesome game, feel free to join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord community channel[/url] and tell us your ideas and wishes.

Comments and reviews on Steam are also much appreciated! <3

Cheers,
Team PowerBeatsVR

notes.title: Fitness Update v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Big News!

PowerBeatsVR just got a huge fitness boost with our latest update: Besides[b] lots of polish[/b], some fixes, and new requested options from you, there is now an [b]advanced calorie counter[/b], [b]player statistics[/b], and [b]unique support for heart rate monitors[/b] to track your fitness level and make the calorie counter one of the most accurate available in VR.

For more details about which heart rate monitors are supported, head over to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/810500/discussions/0/1640918469746747697/]community post[/url].

And here are all the changes in detail:

[b]New Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a sophisticated calorie tracker based on age, weight, gender, controller movement, and heart rate as optional input. Burnt calories are stored for a single session, a custom period, and for the entire lifetime, and are shown during a challenge, on the endscreen and in the menu.
[*] Added unique support for commercial heart rate monitors to show your heart rate in-game. The heart rate will also be analysed after each challenge and used for making the calorie tracker more accurate. 
[/list]
[b]Menu:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the option to enable/disable hints
[*] Added the option to adjust the playspace warning or even disable it completely
[*] Added the option to reset the calorie count shown for the custom period
[*] Added the option to enable/disable graphics beautification
[*] Added saving to the visibility of the Options and Credits panel
[*] Condensed the options and parts of the menu
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing/low haptic feedback 
[*] Added Tracked Motion to statistics after each challenge
[*] Added fitness and VR tips to loading screens
[*] Enabled pause when system button gets pressed
[/list]
[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved sharpness and contrast of graphics (beautification)
[*] Changed the destruction effect of boulders to being shattered into lots of small pieces with enough force applied
[*] Polished particle effects for touching the streams
[*] Polished stream visuals
[*] Made environments brighter and more friendly
[*] Polished the space environment
[*] Polished the feedback visualization
[*] Added various skyboxes to the desert and medieval environment
[*] Changed the start-up room to being a futuristic gym
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an alternative drum-like and more subtle destruction sound
[*] Set default volume to 50%
[*] Removed the sound that was played whenever the powerfist was fully charged
[/list]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized the particle effects
[/list]

As always, we would love to get your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/powerbeatsvr]Discord community server[/url] about the update and the features you want to see next. 

Comments and reviews on Steam are also much appreciated!

Happy calorie burning!
Team PowerBeatsVR

notes.title: PowerBeatsVR v1.1.0 Update Notes: VR Level Editor & Custom Song Support
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34240477/189e0ee607b326ff66d74fe2ddd8917349eb0316.jpg[/img]

Hey PowerBeatsVR players!

Great news: We’ve released the highly requested level editor and the custom song support. [b]Now you can create beatmaps for your own music from the comfort of VR and see directly how the challenges are going to be.[/b]

Since this is an early version, some features we’d like to add are not yet available, among them simple in-game sharing. Right now, if you want to share, just send the files to your friends or share the beatmaps in the [url=https://discord.gg/ZuT8yGc]#community-maps channel[/url] of our Discord server.[b] Please note that uploading songs for which you have no permission is not allowed there.[/b] Always respect the copyright of the individual song.

For more details about how to implement custom songs and use the VR level editor, head over to our blog post at https://www.powerbeatsvr.com/vr-fitness-game/level-editor-released/.

We are excited to see what you are going to create with the editor. We have pre-filled the custom song folder with some new songs (without beatmaps) and an official track (“Galaxies”) you can use as a template for creating your own challenges.

But there is even more. Besides having developed these two features, we also listened to your valuable feedback and made some changes, upgrades, and fixes in the following areas:

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added hit velocity to scoring on Beginner level
[*] Added “no wall” modifier 
[*] Changed the glowing balls to “powerballs” which require twice as much hit speed as the “normal balls”
[*] Fixed a bug which led to showing even a score of 0 on some occasions
[*] Added previous best highscore to the statistics panel after each challenge
[/list]
[b]Songs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new song with Beginner, Advanced, and Expert layouts: “The Planet” from Agenda 23 
[/list]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance of the orbs within the space environment
[*] Restricted the full destruction sound to playing only once within 0.1s
[*] Restricted the full destruction particle effect to playing only once within 0.1s
[*] Fixed the credit screen lag within the menu
[/list]
[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the contrast within the Space environment
[*] Fixed the physically incorrect movement of the debris
[*] Made the impact ground shockwave more responsive
[*] Added some score animations on special events
[*] Fixed the switching of the trees to 2D billboards on lower quality settings
[*] Fixed the billboard rotation of the grass textures
[/list]
[b]Menu:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the hard-to-use quality settings
[*] Added enabling/disabling bloom as an option
[*] Added music volume control
[*] Added SFX volume control
[*] Added switching between official and custom challenges
[*] Added the playspace size as text values
[*] Made the menu slightly bigger
[*] Separated credits from options
[*] Separated gameplay, video, and sound options
[*] Added some menu animations
[*] Rearranged the settings, credits, and highscore buttons
[*] Added saving to the visibility of the highscore panel
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the default volume significantly
[*] Added a stop to the “fully charged” sound loop of the powerfist, the shield deploy sound and powerfist release sound after a song has been finished
[/list]

As always, we hope you enjoy the update and would love to get your feedback. So join us on our Discord community server at http://Discord.gg/Powerbeatsvr.

And if you want to know what’s coming next, head over to our Development Roadmap on Trello: https://trello.com/b/2yNQWbbJ/powerbeatsvr-development-roadmap.

Until next time,
Team PowerBeatsVR

notes.title: PowerBeatsVR v1.0.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34240477/2c07124fd1f3753db4cb33e628da2a0a5b774ea6.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

this is just a short hotfix to handle the random FPS drops, which occurred on some systems due to a bug in Unity (the game’s engine) whenever the game window lost focus. 

Until now, the solution was to click within the game window to restore focus and the normal FPS values. With this hotfix, the game should restore the normal framerate whenever you start a challenge if the bug happened before during long inactivity. This is only a temporary solution and will become obsolete as soon as the bug is fixed within Unity.

Feel free to contact us, if you are still having some issues with that.  You can join the PowerBeatsVR community on [url=https://discord.gg/Ex5fYjd]our Discord server[/url] and chat with us there. Also, if you have ideas or feedback you want to share, please tell us. We would love to hear from you!

Cheers,
the 5 guys behind PowerBeatsVR
